paragraphs: Rav Yehudah son of Rav Shmuel bar Shilat, in Rav's name: Berakhot 47a, 48a; Shabbat 30b, 118b. Shoel, Shabbat 153a, beginning, has bar Shila; Ein Yaakov has Shilat. [The checked Bavli also reads Shilat.] Eruvin 14b: Rav Yehudah bar Shmuel; Asheri has bar Shilat. [The checked Rosh on Eruvin reads bar Shila.] Eruvin 97a; Taanit 14a, 29b, three statements. Megillah 5a, several statements. Menachot 35b; Shabbat 119b has bar Rav Shmuel, with bar Shilat in Asheri, in Rav's name. Shabbat 38a: Rav Yehudah bar Shmuel said: R. Abba said: Rav Kahana said: Rav said. Rif's chain differs: Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah said: Rav Yehudah said. Asheri has Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah said: R. Assi said: Rav Huna said: Rav said. It requires correction.
